interpretation: MEDICAL misses are driven by condition-keyword-list coverage, NOT by name absence (the condition regex fires independent of PERSON detection) — conditions outside the ~20-item hardcoded list (endometriosis, psoriasis, fibromyalgia, IBS, eczema, gout, vertigo, and common abbreviations like T2DM/HTN) are missed regardless of whether a name is present. No-name realistic FNR measured at 58.3%, worse than the previously-guessed 15-40% range. ENTERPRISE_CONFIDENTIAL has no keyword-regex supplement at all; detection relies entirely on incidental Presidio PERSON/DATE_TIME hits (e.g. tagging 'Friday' or 'Q4' as DATE_TIME) rather than recognizing the actual sensitive project/deal content — the 75-80% 'recall' measured here is not a reliable signal that the confidential content itself was what triggered isolation.
